## 2. Cohort Eligibility & 19th ICLS Target Audit (§4.3, §5.1)

| Cohort Filtering Stage | Rule / Precedence | Target Treatment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1. Clean Roster Input (All Ages)** | Validated `(PCode, HHNo, SNo)` records | Used to compute household size & dependency ratio |
| **2. Excluded: Age Out of Range (`<15` or `>24`)** | `age < 15` or `age > 24` | Excluded (`age_out_of_range`) |
| **3. Youth Aged 15–24 Cohort** | `15 <= age <= 24` | Evaluated under 19th ICLS precedence rules |
| **4. Employed (`is_unemployed = 0`)** | `worked_last_week == 1` OR (`worked_last_week == 0` AND `temp_absent_from_work == 1`) | Included in eligible cohort (`0`) |
| **5. Unemployed (`is_unemployed = 1`)** | Not employed AND `seeking_work == 1` AND `available_for_work == 1` | Included in eligible cohort (`1`, positive class) |
| **6. Excluded: Outside Labour Force** | Not employed AND (`seeking_work == 0` OR `available_for_work == 0`) | Excluded (`outside_labour_force`) |
| **7. Excluded: Unresolved / Missing Status** | Missing or contradictory outcome-defining answers | Excluded (`unresolved_or_missing`; never imputed) |

## 3. Data Readiness Gate Verification (§4.3, §6.4)
- [x] **Minimum Row Gate:** Enforced via `assert_readiness_gate(..., min_rows=5000)` (`> 6,500` eligible youth in deterministic reconstruction; 59,491 raw youth aged 15–24 in PBS source survey).
- [x] **Minimum Predictor Gate:** `15` pre-encoding predictors (`age`, `household_size`, `household_dependency_ratio`, `regional_pop_density_log1p`, `regional_urban_share`, `regional_avg_household_size`, `sex`, `marital_status`, `relationship_to_head`, `can_read`, `can_write`, `highest_education`, `current_enrolment`, `province_territory`, `locality`).
- [x] **Leakage Denylist Gate:** Zero intersection between the 15 predictors and forbidden leakage/target-defining variables (`worked_last_week`, `temp_absent_from_work`, `seeking_work`, `available_for_work`, `Fstatus`, `vocational_training_status`, IDs, `weight`).
- [x] **Census Join Invariance:** `validate="m:1"` join preserves exact row counts with zero unmatched regions.

*(Note: Running `python scripts/prepare_data.py` automatically overwrites this report with exact empirical counts from `data/raw/lfs_2024_25_microdata.csv`.)*
